query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T07:00:00Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.rule != "Sudo execution"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule = falco.rule
| SORT events DESC
values: Redirect STDOUT/STDIN to Network Connection in Container
Launch Ingress Remote File Copy Tools in Container
Launch Suspicious Network Tool in Container
Drop and execute new binary in container
Launch Package Management Process in Container
